description: Finds services on the Agent Discovery Board for a need. Say it in plain words in `need` (e.g. 'a free MCP server that checks invoices under $0.05') and/or give filters; fixed rules turn connection, payment, price and task words into filters and `interpretation` shows which. Matches whose name or opening describes the need come first; for a verification need, services with a template and a passing probe come first; a rarer word weighs more. `relaxations` says what dropping a constraint would give. Returns up to `limit` compact matches (a service two sources list is one match: also_listed_as) and next_actions with ids filled in. Stale listings are hidden unless include_stale. Deterministic. Free, no payment or account required.

agent_id.description: Optional label for yourself (usage statistics only).

exclude_payment_type.description: Leave out services that declare any of these payment types: ['free', 'x402', 'mpp', 'ap2', 'acp', 'l402', 'api_key', 'subscription', 'unknown']. A need that says 'no api key' sets it to ['api_key'].

has_template.description: true: only services with a verification template; false: only those without.

include_no_connection.description: Also return listings with no way to connect (only a repository or package page).

include_stale.description: Also return stale listings (hidden by default).

max_price_usd.description: Highest price in USD (matched only against recognised USD stablecoins).

need.description: What you need done, in plain words, at most 300 characters, e.g. 'a free MCP server that checks invoices'. Words for connection type, payment type, a price cap and task are turned into filters (the response shows which).

network.description: CAIP-2 chain id the service must accept payment on, e.g. 'eip155:8453'.

probe_status.description: Last health probe (any of): passing, failing, unprobed, none (never probed).

source.description: Where the listing came from (any of), e.g. mcp_registry, x402_bazaar; 'none' for directly submitted ones.

task_category.description: Explicit task categories (any of); see the manifest's taskCategories.

trace_id.description: trace_id from a previous response, to continue a conversation; omit on the first call.

name: find_agents
title: Find agents for a need
